rationale_md:
Initial planning pass for M1-entrada.

- Every `draft:*` task is promoted to a concrete issue via `replaces_draft`.
- The ScarlettX failing-tests group keeps its two sub-issues.
- `draft:realdody/americas-recomp/xgameruntime-standin` becomes a grouping issue with three small sub-issues (coverage table first, then XTaskQueue and offline XUser).
- Acceptance criteria are defined for `R0Y00/Xbox2Windows#126`, which moves from `needs_info` to `ready`.
- One extra small test task is added for the Xbox2Windows PE loader.

No operation touches the protected objective.

operations.title: Document per-stage system value layout (compute, mesh, geometry)
operations.body_md:
Document the register/semantic layout of system values for the compute, mesh and geometry stages, with evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- A Markdown table per stage lists each system value, its register and component mask.
- Each entry cites its evidence (disassembly or hardware capture); unverified entries are explicitly marked.
- No proprietary shader binaries or game data are committed.

task.instructions_md: Document the register/semantic layout of system values for the compute, mesh and geometry stages, with evidence.

acceptance.text: A Markdown table per stage lists each system value, its register and component mask.
Each entry cites its evidence; unverified entries are explicitly marked.
No proprietary shader binaries or game data are committed.

operations.title: Group: fix the 3 failing ScarlettX tests
operations.body_md:
Grouping issue tracking the currently failing ScarlettX tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- All child issues are closed.
- The full ScarlettX test suite passes on CI.

task.instructions_md: Grouping issue; close when all child issues are closed and the suite passes.

acceptance.text: All child issues are closed and the full ScarlettX test suite passes on CI.

operations.title: Fix guest texture upload lagging one frame (test_d3d12_guest_texture)
operations.body_md:
Guest texture uploads become visible one frame late. Make the upload visible in the frame it is submitted.

## Acceptance criteria
- test_d3d12_guest_texture passes.
- A regression test asserts the uploaded texel is readable in the same frame.
- No other test regresses.

task.instructions_md: Make guest texture uploads visible in the same frame they are submitted.

acceptance.text: test_d3d12_guest_texture passes and a same-frame regression test is added.

operations.title: Child-process boot must not load xgameruntime.dll from System32
operations.body_md:
When booting in a child process, the loader resolves xgameruntime.dll from System32 instead of the bundled stand-in. Fix the DLL search order.

## Acceptance criteria
- The child-process boot test passes.
- A test verifies the loaded xgameruntime.dll path is the stand-in, not System32.

task.instructions_md: Fix the DLL search order so child-process boot loads the stand-in xgameruntime.dll.

acceptance.text: The child-process boot test passes and asserts the stand-in DLL path is used.

operations.title: Implement Xbox BCPack texture decoder
operations.body_md:
Add a BCPack decoder that outputs standard BCn blocks, tested only with synthetic fixtures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Decoder converts BCPack streams to BCn blocks byte-exactly for the committed synthetic fixtures.
- Unit tests cover malformed/truncated input without panics.
- No game textures are committed.

task.instructions_md: Implement a BCPack-to-BCn decoder with synthetic test fixtures only.

acceptance.text: Byte-exact BCn output for committed synthetic fixtures.
Malformed/truncated input handled without panics; no game textures committed.

operations.title: Measure fp16 interpolant rounding and retire XBOX_ALLOW_UNMEASURED_F16_INTERP
operations.body_md:
Measure fp16 interpolant rounding on hardware, encode it in the recompiler and remove the XBOX_ALLOW_UNMEASURED_F16_INTERP escape hatch.

## Acceptance criteria
- A Markdown report documents the measurement method and results.
- The recompiler emits the measured rounding; tests cover denormals and ties.
- XBOX_ALLOW_UNMEASURED_F16_INTERP is removed.

task.instructions_md: Measure fp16 interpolant rounding, implement it, and remove the unmeasured escape hatch.

acceptance.text: Measured rounding implemented with edge-case tests; XBOX_ALLOW_UNMEASURED_F16_INTERP removed.

operations.title: Group: complete the xgameruntime.dll stand-in (48 of 398 methods)
operations.body_md:
Grouping issue for completing the xgameruntime.dll stand-in, split into small, independently testable child issues.

## Acceptance criteria
- All child issues are closed.
- The method coverage table is up to date.

task.instructions_md: Grouping issue; close when all child issues are closed.

acceptance.text: All child issues are closed and the coverage table is up to date.

operations.title: Generate a method coverage table for the xgameruntime stand-in
operations.body_md:
Add a script that lists all 398 xgameruntime interface methods and marks each as implemented, stubbed or missing.

## Acceptance criteria
- The script outputs a Markdown table committed under docs/.
- A test fails if the table is out of date.

task.instructions_md: Write a coverage script and commit its Markdown output.

acceptance.text: Coverage table committed under docs/ and checked for staleness by a test.

operations.title: Implement XTaskQueue methods in the xgameruntime stand-in
operations.body_md:
Implement the XTaskQueue family (create, dispatch, submit callback, close) in the stand-in.

## Acceptance criteria
- All XTaskQueue methods are implemented, not stubbed.
- Unit tests cover manual and thread-pool dispatch modes.

task.instructions_md: Implement XTaskQueue methods with unit tests.

acceptance.text: XTaskQueue methods implemented with tests for manual and thread-pool dispatch.

operations.title: Implement offline XUser stubs in the xgameruntime stand-in
operations.body_md:
Implement the XUser methods needed for one offline local user (add user, get id, gamertag) returning deterministic values.

## Acceptance criteria
- XUser methods return documented deterministic offline values.
- Unit tests cover each implemented method.

task.instructions_md: Implement deterministic offline XUser methods with unit tests.

acceptance.text: Deterministic offline XUser methods implemented and unit-tested.

operations.title: Add malformed-PE regression tests for pe_map_image
operations.body_md:
Add small hand-crafted malformed PE fixtures (truncated headers, bad section alignment, empty relocation directory) and assert pe_map_image rejects them cleanly.

## Acceptance criteria
- At least 5 synthetic malformed PE fixtures are committed (no real game binaries).
- pe_map_image returns an error and never crashes for each fixture.
- Tests run in CI.

task.instructions_md: Add synthetic malformed-PE fixtures and tests for pe_map_image.

acceptance.text: At least 5 synthetic malformed PE fixtures; pe_map_image rejects each without crashing; tests run in CI.

operations.change_md:
Acceptance criteria for R0Y00/Xbox2Windows#126 (decode the XMemAlloc attribute word, Bink and AMD callers):
- A Markdown document describes every bit field of the XMemAlloc attribute word (bit range, name, observed values), each citing evidence from the Bink and AMD call sites.
- A decode helper maps an attribute word to a structured value, with unit tests covering every observed caller value.
- Unknown bits are explicitly flagged as unknown rather than guessed.
- No proprietary binaries or disassembly dumps are committed.
